broad: symbiont-mediated perturbation of host signal transduction pathway via antagonism of host cell surface receptor

definition: A process by which a symbiont alters or subverts a host cell surface receptor-mediated signal transduction pathway by binding to and inhibiting the receptor of the pathway. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: symbiont-mediated suppression of host signal transduction pathway via antagonism of host cell surface receptor
